description_en: Queries all applications, specific applications, or specific application groups supported by Smart Access Gateway (SAG) in a specified region
description_zh: 查询指定地域下指定的应用信息、指定的应用组信息或智能接入网关在指定地域下支持的全部应用信息
kebab_example: aliyun smartag list-dpi-signatures --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb20000 --max-results 20 --dpi-group-id 20 --dpi-signature-ids 235 --dpi-signature-names EdgeCast --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDpiSignatures

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html operation to query the regions and their IDs that are supported by SAG
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69813.html查询智能接入网关支持的地域以及对应的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The token for the next page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of applications to return on each page.

Valid values: **1** to **100**.

Default value: **20**
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页展示的应用个数。

取值范围：**1**~**100**。

默认值：**20**
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: dpi_group_id
